concurrency: Single-threaded caller-driven execution; no service, daemon, thread or network is created.
inputs: caller run id, clocks, limits and obligations
outputs: offline JSON/JSONL evidence inside the run root
purpose: Require the caller to supply the run identity, clock identities/units, finite limits and evidence obligations; operate offline on JSON/JSONL only with no ambient clock, random identity, remote lookup or environment discovery and no control, metric, oracle, tap or network capability.
state: Owns only the caller-supplied authority values (identity, clocks, limits, obligations) and the offline run root.

static_checks.expected: ast.parse succeeds for every planned path; no ambient identity/clock/limit or network fallback exists
static_checks.rule: python ast parse of the planned api/limits sources plus a check that run id, limits, clocks and obligations are function parameters with no environment, locale, home-directory, random or network fallback
static_checks.tool: repository static inspection (python ast parse and diff/wheel scope check; consumed by the trusted ARGUS2-STATIC measure)

title: ARGUS2-SR-011-U unit specification - Caller authority, offline operation and absence of control authority

unit_cases.expected: rejected; ARGUS2-INPUT-AUTHORITY-MISSING; no identity is generated
unit_cases.precondition: open_run called with no run id

unit_cases.expected: the effective caller limits are echoed into the manifest so the reader verifies under the same bounds
unit_cases.precondition: a caller limit set supplied explicitly

unit_cases.expected: the declared obligations are recorded verbatim; no obligation is invented, defaulted or removed
rejected; ARGUS2-INPUT-FIELD-INVALID; only the four frozen obligation kinds exist
unit_cases.precondition: an obligation whose kind is outside the closed set

unit_cases.expected: the whole lifecycle completes with no socket or network access
no subprocess, service, daemon or background worker is started
no metric-computation or evaluation-oracle entry point is exposed or importable
only JSON/JSONL evidence artifacts are produced; no control, actuation or provider-delivery output exists
unit_cases.stimulus: enumerate run-root artifacts and return values

unit_cases.expected: every written artifact is JSON or JSONL; no database, socket, binary blob, parquet or side-channel file appears
unit_cases.precondition: a run with events plus an imported observation and snapshot

unit_cases.expected: no remote lookup, locale, environment or home-directory value influences identity, clocks, limits or verdicts
unit_cases.precondition: an environment with proxy/user/home variables set

unit_cases.expected: no admitted fact changes and the writer holds no reference to a caller-owned mutable object; admission deep-snapshots every caller value (ARGUS2-ADV-07)
unit_cases.precondition: caller-supplied run_envelope, source_byte_digests, clocks, extensions and obligations objects
unit_cases.stimulus: open_run(...); mutate every caller-owned object after admission; inspect the manifest and the evaluated obligations
